item.title: How LGBTQ+ rights funding collapsed in 2025
item.description: The US and other countries cut funding for LGBTQ+ rights as a global backlash spreads, but activists vow to keep up their work.

item.title: Taiwan hits fine particle goal, turns focus to ozone and ultrafine pollution
item.description: Officials warn climate change is complicating ozone control as government moves to regulate VOCs and launch PM0.1 monitoring.

item.title: Swire group head of sustainability Mark Harper departs
item.description: The Briton moves on after almost a decade with the Hong Kong-based conglomerate, which recently trimmed its workforce amid economic headwinds in China.

item.title: Singapore doubles transition period for drinks deposit scheme amid industry constraints
item.description: Beverage producers say they will struggle to clear existing stock and comply with new labelling requirements in time.

item.title: Taiwan shifts plastic policy away from bans, sets new reduction targets
item.description: New targets focus on incentives and circular economy after earlier phase-out goals missed.

item.title: What is China’s contribution to climate finance?
item.description: Though there is no official tracking, China’s green investments in the Global South have been vast.

item.title: Protected area? Industry under fire for Philippine sea spill
item.description: Tañon Strait spill raises alarm over Philippine marine safeguards.

item.title: Climate adaptation more than covers its cost
item.description: At 2°C warming, US$1.2 trillion a year is needed to protect everyone exposed to climate hazards. That may sound expensive, but the benefits of this adaptation would exceed the cost by roughly seven times.

item.title: Is Malaysia heading towards an uninsurability crisis?
item.description: A growing tranche of real estate assets is at increasing risk of climate-related physical damage, but these risks cannot simply be priced or insured away.

item.title: Philippines cuts climate budget by nearly 15 per cent in 2026
item.description: The country signs national spending plan as civil society groups warn funds favour infrastructure over environmental protection.
